title: 第90章  你压着我头发了
slug: 四合院开局绑定空间农场
content_zh:
吃饱喝足，天已黑透。他把碗碟用开水烫了端到水槽边洗干净，回来刚把暖水瓶灌满，就瞧见对面阎埠贵一家老小，裹得严严实实，拿着面袋子和油瓶子正要出门。阎埠贵说要早些去粮站排队，早弄回来心里才踏实。

很快，院里人相继动身，连易中海、刘海中、何雨柱家也都出来了。刘海中腆着肚子问李阳能不能想办法让他们不用排队，被易中海和何雨柱一顿怼——人情不是这么用的。李阳冲刘海中摊了摊手，笑着说都正常人，就您迷糊。刘海中干笑两声，说就是开个玩笑。

等人都走光了，院子一下子安静下来。李阳打了盆水洗脸烫脚，倒水时正好碰上秦淮茹从中院出来。她往左右扫了一眼，走上前来问李阳怎么没跟着去粮站。李阳笑了一声：“我要去了，你晚上吃什么？”

秦淮茹笑得更甜了，抿着嘴小声说家里就剩她和小当，贾东旭他们都去粮站了。李阳有些意外——贾东旭不是把口粮输了吗？秦淮茹说口粮输了也得把粮食领回来，不然拿什么还赌债。李阳呵呵一笑，让她早点过来。

李阳回到屋里，从空间里取出几个细棒子面窝头热上，又打了一碗胡辣汤温在锅里。今晚给秦淮茹就吃这个——天天吃饺子也不是那么回事。准备好之后他把火盆点上，先让屋里暖和起来。

不一会儿秦淮茹抱着小当推门进来了，说放家里怕她哭。李阳把小当接过来抱进里间，让秦淮茹自己去锅里端吃的。秦淮茹端着窝头和胡辣汤进来时，眼睛都亮了——汤里竟然搁了花生碎，鲜香浓郁，麻辣可口，喝下去浑身暖烘烘的。她饿了一整天，全靠灌凉水撑着，这会儿细嚼慢咽地吃着，才感觉是活着。

吃饱喝足，秦淮茹把碗筷洗干净，回来接过小当，先把孩子哄睡了搁在脚头——那儿有盐水瓶捂着，暖和得很。她回过身来，伸手摁住就要凑上前的李阳，小声说知道他爱干净，先打点水擦擦身子。

李阳眼神一亮，点头应了，说要看着。秦淮茹的脸蛋一下子红透了，剜了他一眼却没阻止。反正早就叫他吃干抹净了，看看也少不了什么，坏了他的兴致反倒不美。

秦淮茹端了盆热水进来，在李阳目不转睛的注视下羞臊得脸红得像熟透的苹果，几次想转过身去，却还是顺着他的意思没有躲开。暖黄的油灯光铺在她身上，把那些圆润的弧线镀上了一层柔和的蜜色，李阳的目光追着那道光，从肩窝一路滑到腰侧，再从腰侧缓缓往下，看得秦淮茹连指尖都有些发抖了。

“丑死了，有什么好看的。”她咬着嘴唇，声音轻得几乎听不见。

李阳笑了笑，说不丑，迷死人了都。秦淮茹终于撑不住了，把水端到一边，还没来得及转身就被李阳拦腰抱了起来。两个人一起倒进了被窝里，暖烘烘的火盆把屋里的寒气全逼了出去，只剩下两个人的呼吸声越来越急促，像两股被同一阵风搅在一起的炊烟，缠缠绕绕地往上飘。秦淮茹的胳膊攀着他的脖子，手指插进他后脑勺的头发里轻轻攥着，偶尔收紧一下，指甲陷进他的头发里又松开，像是在攥一根救命的绳子。

过了好一阵，屋里才渐渐安静下来。秦淮茹小声提醒说他压着她头发了，李阳让了让，她赶紧把头发拢到另一边，重新钻进他怀里，手指绕着自己一缕发丝慢慢把玩。

“我现在倒是跟你过的日子多些。”她忽然低声说了一句，语气里带着一丝自己都没察觉的感慨。

李阳低头看了她一眼，说这段时间她倒成了他大半个女人。秦淮茹抬起头来，眼睛里带着一丝困惑——怎么才大半个，另外小半个跑哪儿去了？

李阳拍了拍她的肩膀，叹了口气说另外小半个永远在贾家那边，抢也抢不走。秦淮茹恍然，说她是贾家的媳妇，在那边生儿育女，不在那边又能在哪里。她又反问了一句——难道他愿意替贾家养孩子？李阳毫不犹豫地说了句想都别想。

“我就知道。”秦淮茹嘟了嘟嘴，“所以嘛，那小半个你永远也抢不去——不过我也没打算不给你，只要你不嫌弃，我会一直来陪你。就是以后你娶了媳妇，再来怕就不那么方便了。”

李阳嘿嘿一笑，说这事不用她操心，到时候自有办法。秦淮茹忽然提议说要是他娶了京茹就好了，她来串门就方便不少。李阳问她这回可是真心话，不会再使绊子了？秦淮茹说上次被他罚怕了，哪儿还敢再使心眼。

李阳看了她一眼，说了句意味深长的话——希望她言而有信，要不然休怪他无情。秦淮茹问他就不怕自己鱼死网破？李阳笑了一声，说你大可试试，到时候他就跟人说她想讹钱讹粮，看院里人是信她还是信他。真要闹大了，把她送街道办或派出所，让她吃牢饭也不是做不出来。

秦淮茹抿嘴一笑，正要接话，李阳忽然伸手按住她的嘴唇，侧耳听了片刻，压低了声音说有脚步声——八成是她婆婆带着棒梗回来了。

秦淮茹一愣，问他这都能听出来。李阳只说是跟人学的把式，让她别往外说。秦淮茹也不敢耽搁，连忙起身穿衣服。李阳说几个大爷明儿一准把粮食送她家去。秦淮茹说这次还多亏了他，听婆婆说是他给三个大爷出的主意，要不然这个月全家真得喝西北风。

她穿戴妥当，抱起熟睡的小当，走到门口又折回来，在李阳嘴上轻轻啄了一口，才转身悄然离去。李阳掀开窗帘一角往外瞄了一眼，果然看见贾张氏带着棒梗正往中院走，便放下帘子，重新躺回被窝里。明儿还有许多事要办——去街道办找王主任拿票证，给各家各户还粮，还得跑一趟百货大楼问自行车的价钱。他把被子往身上拢了拢，闭上了眼。
content_en:
After eating and drinking, it was already dark.He scalded the dishes with boiling water and took them to the sink to wash them. When he came back and filled up the thermos bottle, he saw Yan Bugui's family opposite, all bundled up tightly and about to go out with flour bags and oil bottles.Yan Bugui said that he would go to the grain station early to queue up, and he would feel at ease after getting it back early.

Soon, people in the courtyard left one after another, including Yi Zhonghai, Liu Haizhong, and He Yuzhu's family.Liu Haizhong shyly asked Li Yang if he could think of a way to save them from queuing, but Yi Zhonghai and He Yuzhu scolded him - that's not how favors work.Li Yang spread his hands towards Liu Haizhong, smiled and said that they are all normal people, you are the only one who is confused.Liu Haizhong laughed dryly and said it was just a joke.

When everyone was gone, the courtyard suddenly became quiet.Li Yang fetched a basin of water to wash his face and hot his feet. When he was pouring water, he happened to meet Qin Huairu coming out of the central courtyard.She glanced left and right, stepped forward and asked Li Yang why he didn't follow him to the grain station.Li Yang laughed: "I'm going. What are you eating for dinner?"

Qin Huairu smiled even sweeter, pursed her lips and whispered that she and Xiaodang were the only ones left at home, while Jia Dongxu and the others went to the grain station.Li Yang was a little surprised - didn't Jia Dongxu lose the rations?Qin Huairu said that if he lost the ration, he had to get it back, otherwise he would have nothing to pay off the gambling debt.Li Yang laughed and asked her to come over early.

Li Yang returned to the house, took out a few thin stick noodles steamed buns from the space and heated them up, and also made a bowl of spicy soup to warm in the pot.This is what Qin Huairu will eat tonight - eating dumplings every day is not the same thing.After getting ready, he lit the brazier to warm up the room first.

After a while, Qin Huairu opened the door and came in with Xiaodang in her arms, saying that she was afraid she would cry if she was left at home.Li Yang took Xiaodang and carried him into the inner room, and asked Qin Huairu to go to the pot and bring the food.Qin Huairu's eyes lit up when she came in with steamed buns and spicy soup - there were crushed peanuts in the soup, which was rich in flavor, spicy and delicious, and her whole body was warm after drinking it.She had been hungry all day and relied on cold water to survive. Now she ate slowly and carefully, and she felt alive.

After eating and drinking, Qin Huairu washed the dishes and chopsticks, came back to take the basket, put the child to sleep first and put it on his feet - there was a bottle of salt water covering it, which was very warm.She turned around, stretched out her hands to hold down Li Yang, who was about to come forward, and whispered that she knew he loved to be clean, so she should get some water to wipe himself first.

Li Yang's eyes lit up and he nodded in agreement, saying he would watch.Qin Huairu's face turned red all of a sudden, and she glanced at him but did not stop him.Anyway, I had already told him to eat and drink everything, and there was nothing missing. It would be bad if it ruined his mood.

Qin Huairu came in with a basin of hot water. Under Li Yang's unblinking gaze, her face turned red like a ripe apple with embarrassment. She wanted to turn around several times, but still followed his intention and did not avoid it.The warm yellow oil lamp was spread on her body, coating those rounded arcs with a soft honey color. Li Yang's eyes followed the light, sliding from the shoulder to the waist, and then slowly downward from the waist, making Qin Huairu's fingertips tremble a little.

"It's so ugly, what's so good about it?" She bit her lip, her voice so soft that it was almost inaudible.

Li Yang smiled and said he was not ugly, he was so charming.Qin Huairu finally couldn't hold on any longer and took the water aside. Before she could turn around, she was picked up by Li Yang.The two people fell into bed together, and the warm brazier forced all the cold air out of the room. The only sound left was the breathing of the two people getting faster and faster, like two streams of smoke stirred together by the same gust of wind, floating upwards in a tangled manner.Qin Huairu's arms were hanging around his neck, her fingers were inserted into the hair on the back of his head and she was holding it gently, occasionally tightening it, her nails digging into his hair and then releasing it, as if she was holding on to a life-saving rope.

After a while, the room gradually became quiet.Qin Huairu reminded in a low voice that he was holding her hair down, and Li Yang gave in. She quickly moved her hair to the other side, got into his arms again, and slowly played with a strand of her hair with her fingers.

"I spend more time with you now." She suddenly whispered, with a trace of emotion in her tone that she didn't even notice.

Li Yang looked down at her and said that during this period she had become more than half of his woman.Qin Huairu raised her head, with a trace of confusion in her eyes - why is it only half of it, and where did the other half go?

Li Yang patted her shoulder, sighed and said that the other half will always be with Jia's family and cannot be snatched away.Qin Huairu suddenly understood and said that she was the daughter-in-law of the Jia family. She gave birth to children there, so where could she be if she wasn't there.She asked again - is he willing to raise children for the Jia family?Li Yang said without hesitation, "Don't even think about it."

"I knew it." Qin Huairu pouted, "So, you can never snatch that little half away - but I have no intention of denying it to you. As long as you don't dislike it, I will always be with you. But after you marry a wife, it won't be so convenient for you to come back."

Li Yang smiled and said that she didn't need to worry about this matter, she would find a solution when the time comes.Qin Huairu suddenly suggested that it would be great if he married Jingru, and it would be much more convenient for her to visit.Li Yang asked her if she was telling the truth this time and wouldn't she stumble again?Qin Huairu said that she was scared of being punished by him last time, so how could she dare to be mean-spirited again.

Li Yang glanced at her and said something meaningful - I hope she will keep her word, otherwise don't blame him for being ruthless.Qin Huairu asked him if he was not afraid that he would be defeated.Li Yang laughed and said you can give it a try. When the time comes, he will tell people that she wants to extort money and food, and see whether the people in the courtyard believe her or him.If things really get serious, it's not impossible to send her to the street office or the police station and let her go to jail.

Qin Huairu pursed her lips and smiled, and was about to answer when Li Yang suddenly reached out and pressed her lips, listened for a moment, lowered his voice and said there were footsteps - it was probably her mother-in-law who came back with a stick.

Qin Huairu was stunned and asked if he could hear this.Li Yang only said that she learned the moves from others and asked her not to tell anyone else.Qin Huairu didn't dare to delay and quickly got up and put on her clothes.Li Yang said that some uncles would send food to her house tomorrow.Qin Huairu said that it was thanks to him this time. Her mother-in-law said that it was he who gave the three uncles the idea, otherwise the whole family would really suffer from the northwest wind this month.

She was fully dressed, picked up the sleeping Xiao Dang, walked to the door and then came back, gave Li Yang a gentle peck on the mouth, then turned around and left quietly.Li Yang opened the corner of the curtain and took a look outside. Sure enough, he saw Mrs. Jia Zhang walking towards the middle courtyard with a stick, so he lowered the curtain and lay back on the bed.There are still many things to do tomorrow - go to the subdistrict office to get tickets from Director Wang, pay back food to each household, and go to a department store to ask about the price of bicycles.He pulled the quilt closer to his body and closed his eyes.
